name: gephyra
description: Provider switch for the Claude Code extension: Anthropic ⇄ any Anthropic-compatible endpoint (z.ai GLM, Kimi, …) via named env profiles, per project, busy-gated — plus one-command beam of the active session to your phone via Remote Control

commands.title: Gephyra: Switch provider for this project (Claude ⇄ GLM ⇄ …)
Gephyra: Configure Claude Code process wrapper
Gephyra: Beam session to phone (Remote Control)

gephyra.quietWindowMs.description: Transcript must be silent this long before a session counts as idle.

gephyra.switchToast.description: Show the post-switch notification with the [New conversation] shortcut. Off: the status-bar label change is the only confirmation.

gephyra.restartCliOnSwitch.description: After a provider switch, end this window's idle Claude Code CLI process so the next conversation respawns under the new provider (model list updates without a window reload). Only processes backing THIS workspace's open conversations defer; others die immediately. Queued processes die when their conversation closes (no 'exited' banner).

gephyra.anthropicLiveUsage.description: Read LIVE Anthropic usage with the access token Claude Code stores in the macOS Keychain (opt-in; off by default). Read-only: gephyra never refreshes or rewrites that credential. The statusline feed only updates from terminal sessions — enabling this polls the usage endpoint directly, so the bar stays fresh in the panel too. Falls back to the statusline feed on any failure. macOS only.

gephyra.visionProxy.description: Opt-in localhost proxy that keeps a project on GLM/Kimi for text and code but routes image-bearing message turns (and the tool-loops they start) to Anthropic pay-as-you-go, where vision actually works. Requires ~/.config/gephyra/anthropic-vision.env (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY + GEPHYRA_VISION_MODEL). The wrapper only routes through it while that file and the url file exist; on any failure it falls back to direct provider injection (Claude Code never breaks). Scoped, opt-in exception to the no-proxy stance — see DECISIONS.md.

gephyra.visionProxyPort.description: Localhost port for the vision proxy (shared across windows; first window hosts, others reuse). Only meaningful when gephyra.visionProxy is on.

gephyra.visionModel.description: Claude model used for the vision leg (image turns) when gephyra.visionProxy is on. Any current Anthropic model id, e.g. claude-sonnet-5 (default) or claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 for cheaper vision. The API KEY stays in ~/.config/gephyra/anthropic-vision.env (never here); a GEPHYRA_VISION_MODEL in that file overrides this setting if set.
